# PYQ audit worksheet (one row or file per item)

- Internal ID / canonical public ID or reason withheld / version:
- Year, paper/stream, series, printed section and number, source URL/page/date checked:
- Printed stem/options and figure compared? Option order, labels and alt text checked?
- Rule edition/category/max marks; final notice reference/table row and booklet remapping evidence:
- Key tier and status (including withdrawal); explanation checked independently by:
- Syllabus topic, exact lesson section, primary/secondary and why that section teaches it:
- Publication permission/attribution (independent of accuracy):
- Verdict: held / read only / scoreable. Student-facing reason and allowed modes:
- Reviewer, date, unresolved issue, source version and follow-up:
